item.title: No threat found at Haverford High School after bomb threat prompted evacuation
item.description: Students and staff at Haverford High School were evacuated on Wednesday due to a bomb threat.In a letter to families, officials said the school received a phone call regarding a bomb threat shortly after classes started on Wednesday. Students and staff were evacuated to nearby Haverford Middle School where they were later dismissed early.
